## TL;DR
The default `github copilot` model (`default` / `copilot-auto-efficiency`) now maps to the Auto `balance` tier, which exists today, and Copilot tier rejections are turned into plain-English guidance on every failure path. This round fixes review pass 4.

## Work and rationale
- `src/server/agents.ts`: the "engineer turn ended without a handoff" activity line now enriches the stderr value before composing the line, instead of regex-patching the joined string. A `last assistant` text that quotes "stderr: " can no longer be truncated or have guidance spliced into it.
- `src/core/copilot-auto-tier.ts`: the CLI's suggested tiers are split on commas as well as "or", so `balance, intelligence` is two tiers; the guidance never suggests the tier that just failed. Test added in `copilot-auto-tier.test.ts`.
- Earlier rounds on the branch: tier mapping, legacy id alias, enrichment for one-shot, review, engineer banner and agent test, docs.
- Out of scope, stated explicitly: `probeError` in `src/core/models.ts` (the model-list probe) stays raw; the Settings agent test goes through the enriched `model-test.ts`, so acceptance 2 holds.

## Approaches tried
Enriching the segment before composition rather than a safer regex, since any post-hoc string surgery on user-influenced text can mis-hit.

## Challenges and blockers
Not verified live: running with `--auto-tier balance` spends Copilot credits and no probe was run; the CLI's exact multi-tier wording is unverified, which is why both comma and "or" separators are handled.

## Key learnings
Compose failure text from separately enriched parts; never regex-patch the joined string.
